name: Ferienhotel Elvira Pension
beschreibung:
Set in a beautiful location within the scenic Thiersee valley, Ferienhotel Elvira welcomes guests with authentic Tyrolean warmth. Its comfortably equipped rooms provide a restful haven with views of the surrounding mountains.

Nearby Lake Thiersee is perfect for swimming in summer, while hiking paths ascending Mount Pendling and winter cross-country trails start close by.
kurzbeschreibung: Ferienhotel Elvira in Thiersee offers comfortable rooms, lakeside proximity, and welcoming family hospitality in Kufsteinerland.
